name: Advance Floater Pruning
definition: An algorithm to identify and delete low-opacity Gaussians positioned close to the camera center ('floaters') that cause misalignment between mode-selection and alpha-blending depth.
summary: Advance Floater Pruning identifies and removes misplaced Gaussians in 3D Gaussian Splatting by analyzing depth metric discrepancies, distinguishing itself from standard methods by targeting near-camera geometric inconsistencies.
